description: City proposes rezoning 13 properties in five neighbourhoods.

chips.text: First reading passed (9-0)
9 for, 0 against

Residents in Grovener Park, Caswell Hill, Varsity View, Nutana Park, and Nutana are affected.

Nutana Community Association supports rezoning; one resident raised concerns about Preston Avenue.

description: Links zoning bylaw to existing tree protection bylaw.

Amendment impacts urban forest, affecting air quality, shade, and habitat.
